title: Olive and the Lost Pin
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ai, ee, igh

pages.illustration: Olive the grey owl standing on a garden path near a wooden gate.
Close view of Olive the owl holding a small silver pin in one claw.

pages.text: The pin fell off. The pin is not on Olive.
pages.illustration: A small shiny pin falling from Olive the owl onto the path behind her, Olive not noticing.

pages.text: Olive did go back on the path.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl walking back slowly along the path, scanning the ground.

pages.text: Is the pin on this bit? Is the pin on that bit?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl leaning down to check one patch of grass, then another patch further along, side by side in one scene.
Olive the owl still searching carefully along the path, determined, path stretching on behind her.
Olive the owl spotting the small silver pin gleaming in the grass near the wooden gate.

pages.text: Olive has the pin. Olive had fun.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl holding the silver pin again, standing happily by the wooden gate.
